==Skin Trivia==
*Prior to the 4th of March 2020, the '''Sniper''' originally had a KAC M110 SASS rifle and laid in a prone position.
**Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the '''Sniper''' had a position similar to that of the [[Ranger|Outlaw]].
*The original {{Color|Basic|Ghillie}} skin was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/88952246/profile ice22343].
*The {{Color|ColdFront|Silent}} skin appears to be a reference to [[wp:Simo Häyhä|Simo Häyhä]], also known as ''The White Death''.
**He was a Finnish sniper who participated in the [[wp:Winter War|Winter War]]. It was believed he had killed over 500 enemy soldiers during the war and was believed to be the deadliest sniper in history.
*The '''Sniper''', despite wielding a Barrett M82 at Level 4, which is a semi-automatic weapon, still chambers a round.
**The previous version of the '''Sniper''' did not do this.

===Roblox Catalog===
*The original Level 3-4 helmet and mask used by most '''Sniper''' skins is the {{RLinkC|31313130|Sniper Relay Helmet}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The original Level 2 goggles on most skins are a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|833772989|Laser Spec Special Forces Goggles}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The second version of the Level 2-3 {{Color|Basic|Ghillie}} skin used the {{RLinkC|29115479|Spy Vision 7500}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
**The second version of the Level 4-5 {{Color|Basic|Ghillie}} skin used the {{RLinkC|25975717|Ghillie Hat}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
